name: get_control_status
description: Get the current test status of one control (effective, deficient, or not_tested), its owner, test dates, and finding. Control IDs look like CTL-001.

control_id.description: Control ID in the form CTL-NNN, for example CTL-003.

caller_token.description: Set by the agent code from the verified request. Never set by the model.

name: get_evidence_status
description: List the evidence items for one control and whether each is collected or missing, with dates. Control IDs look like CTL-001.

control_id.description: Control ID in the form CTL-NNN, for example CTL-003.

caller_token.description: Set by the agent code from the verified request. Never set by the model.
